WallyBot es un monolito modular: proceso: WallyBot is a modular monolith: independent processes (api, worker, scheduler, research_worker, web) sharing typed domain/application/infrastructure packages under wallybot/. The domain layer (wallybot/domain) never imports FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, CCXT or AI SDKs -- that's an architecture rule, not a style preference.
El detalle completo vive en archivos Mar: The full detail lives in Markdown files at the repo root, not on this page: ARCHITECTURE.md (design and layers), DATA.md (market data), SECURITY.md, RISK.md, TESTING.md and DEPLOYMENT.md. Open them directly in your editor or on GitHub.
Graphify es una herramienta de línea de: Graphify is a command-line tool (not part of the production stack) that turns the repository into a navigable knowledge graph -- useful for understanding how modules relate before touching code.
El primer comando genera un diagrama int: The first command generates an interactive diagram (graphify-out/graph.html) and a plain-text report (graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md) you can open in your browser or editor. It's an optional development tool, not a requirement to run your bot.
Agrega un proveedor en modo lectura o PA: Add a provider in read-only or PAPER mode. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again. Trading keys and withdrawals are never enabled here.
Creá tu propio bot con @BotFather en Tel: Create your own bot with @BotFather on Telegram, paste the token here along with the chat_id you want alerts sent to. The token is encrypted and never shown again once saved.

el camino concreto entre dos símbolos o: the concrete path between two specific symbols or modules.
